title: Surface Multi-Site database bootstrap connectivity failures

opportunity.rootCause: SiteDatabaseStore.TryLoadSnapshot swallowed every NpgsqlException, so a PostgreSQL connectivity or authentication failure could fall through to configuration fallback and only appear later as an authentication 503.
opportunity.risk: The Desktop login window could report Authentication service unavailable while the real startup failure was the database connection, delaying diagnosis and allowing an ambiguous runtime state.

implementation.behavior: TryLoadSnapshot now preserves only the intentional UndefinedTable first-start fallback; other NpgsqlException failures surface to Gateway startup.

red.result: failed 1/1 before implementation because the broad NpgsqlException catch returned null

verification.relatedRegression: passed 79/79 across bootstrap-failure, configuration, editor, persistence, activation, security, health-trend, UI-contract, and handoff classes

boundary: Live PostgreSQL UndefinedTable first-start execution was not available in the focused run

Authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive/screen-reader verification, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified
